VoiceNet dimension LoRAs — HIGH vs LOW

For each VoiceNet perceptual dimension we trained two rank-32 LoRAs on MOSS-TTS-4.55B: one on the high end of that dimension (chavo clips scoring ≥5) and one on the low end (≤1), each with 25% reference mix. The same neutral sentence, same seed, no reference is generated with each adapter so you hear the dimension move in isolation. The number is that dimension's own score of the output (0–1).
